response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with strong full-stack, TypeScript/Node.js, and systems-level (DLang, C/C++) background, plus genuine IDE-adjacent experience at National Instruments. However, the role requires deep, current Java/Kotlin/JVM expertise and hands-on Spring ecosystem experience, neither of which is evidenced in his recent work history — his Java exposure is minor and over 8 years old, and Kotlin and Spring are absent entirely from his skills and project history.
strengths: 15+ years of senior/staff-level engineering experience across web, mobile, and systems programming
Direct prior experience building IDE tooling (National Instruments LabWindows/CVI C IDE)
Strong communication, teaching, and open-source track record (workshops, talks, tooling libraries)
concerns: No Kotlin experience mentioned anywhere in resume or skills
No Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise Java framework experience listed
Core recent expertise (last 5+ years) is TypeScript/Node.js, not JVM languages, missing the 'deep JVM understanding' requirement

key_factors.factor: Lack of Spring/enterprise JVM framework experience
Prior IDE development experience (C IDE at National Instruments)
